upstream.policy: Preserve ancestry; ordinary merge on a review branch; never force-push or auto-deploy

donor.method: Selective feature delta, reconciled against the RuoJi6 implementation

integration_adjustments: Preserve upstream scheduler, active-run clock, worker pools, credentials, evidence, proxy, self-update and user prompts
Quiet planning and consecutive-failure escalation default off
Candidate-only lessons by default; adoption required for injection; task/company scoping
Ignored or accepted risk is caution, not proof of a false positive
Subtract both cache-read and cache-write subsets when estimating fresh-input cost
Private self-updates use only the project's own release source
No import of other ARTEX forks
